description: Ministry of Labour, Trade Union Relations - Notify the Wages Board for the Hotel and Catering Trade
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the approval and implementation of decisions made by the Wages Board for the Hotel and Catering Trade under the Wages Boards Ordinance. It establishes regulatory minimum wage rates for various classes of workers in the industry. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it involves statutory instruments, regulatory frameworks, and compliance requirements established under existing legislation.
